title: the *claim-safe* growth blueprint
dek: The full engagement, assembled: who the buyer is in his own words, the lane nobody measured is holding, the rings and buckets wired to the $750/$2,500 offer ladder, the vehicles with their mechanisms, and a 90-day batch plan with the kill rules written before the first video ships. Every claim labeled; every bet registered up front.
sources: the five underlying reports · 12 channels · 50 receipted rows · 15 buyer verbatims

sections.heading: the call
sections.body: Every channel the supplement founder watches is selling him a mechanism. Nobody is selling him the decision. This engagement claims that lane: the claim-safe launch strategist for operating supplement and performance brands, reached through two narrow buckets and one fenced reach engine, converting attention into $750 Angle Maps and $2,500 Proof-to-Market Sprints, with the proof or the kill signal sitting in his own inbox by batch three. The evidence behind that sentence: twelve channels, fifty receipted outlier rows, fifteen exact buyer verbatims, and zero rows anywhere in the claim-science lane - while the loudest supplement-specific channel actively manufactures the sameness the offer fixes.

sections.heading: the market, last 30 days
sections.tag: WHAT MOVED WHILE THIS WAS WRITTEN · AUG 27

rows.claim: Meta moved supplement ads from category-level rejection toward claim-by-claim review (July 22)
rows.evidence: The reported update changes before/after imagery rules, supplement age-gating, and shop placements — making which claims you run, not whether you run ads, the compliance question. Direct tailwind for the claim-safe lane

rows.claim: AI agents are already sending measurable shopping traffic (Reuters, Aug 7)
rows.evidence: Claude and Gemini agents are directing real retail traffic today, with Juniper Research projecting $8 billion in agent-directed spending this year

rows.claim: Two rival standards for AI-agent shopping went public in early August
rows.evidence: OpenAI's Agentic Commerce Protocol and Google's Universal Commerce Protocol (built with Shopify, Etsy, and Walmart) both signal that being findable and quotable by AI assistants is becoming its own distribution channel

rows.claim: Structured, claim-backed product data is becoming the input AI shopping runs on
rows.evidence: Adobe launched Catalog Agent in mid-August to expose brand catalogs to LLM shopping surfaces (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini) — infrastructure forming behind this blueprint's citation thesis: an AI names the brand whose claims are defensible and whose proof it can cite

rows.claim: Etsy squeezed print-on-demand sellers in the same week it cut 12% of staff
rows.evidence: The tightened Prohibited Items Policy took effect August 11; the layoffs landed August 5-6. Platform-shift anxiety - the reach engine's raw material - has a live, dated story

sections.heading: chapter 1 · who we're for
sections.body:
The Formulator-Founder: 33-50, credentialed face of an already-selling supplement or performance brand under $15M, near-zero time, spending his own runway against a dated occasion inside 60-90 days. His midnight fear - the dossier holds it verbatim - is being the most knowledgeable person in the category while a louder half-expert becomes the name. Content that flatters visibility loses him. Content that arms credibility recruits him.

The discovery that shapes everything: across seven forum threads where this buyer talks, every reply sold a different mechanism - quiz funnels, CAPI hygiene, agency accounts, AI media buyers. Not one told the founder to decide what the brand proves and to whom. The lane has no competition inside the buyer's own feed.

rows.claim: W1 - The Defensible Claim lane: zero of fifty ranked rows touch claims or compliance
rows.evidence: The only supplement-specific channel teaches launch mechanics instead: 'No Warehouse, No Problem' at 33.2x its own baseline. Opening plays scoped: the $53,088 sentence (what one over-claim can cost at the FTC's per-violation penalty), the nine-homepages teardown, honest-claim-vs-lie

rows.claim: W2 - Nobody names the operating supplement founder as their audience
rows.evidence: Supliful aims at pre-revenue aspirants; Marketing Operators and Common Thread aim across all DTC; the giants aim at everyone. The named-audience slot is empty in the measured pool

rows.claim: W3 - All twelve channels install adopt-the-mechanism beliefs; the decision-before-mechanism belief is uninstalled
rows.evidence: The current wave: 'Claude Has Officially Changed Facebook Ads Forever' - 41K views, 21.8x, 2026-08-09. The Fix Aisle grants what the tool does, then names the decision it cannot make

rows.claim: W4 - Pool proof is seller-side scale; buyer-side embodied proof is unclaimed
rows.evidence: The proof register incumbents run: half-billion exits, billionaire weeks. His uncopyable version: 18 years as the buyer's final checkpoint, and the 2018-hype-seller to 2026-claim-safe conversion, documented eight years apart

sections.heading: chapter 3 · the money map
sections.tag: WHICH BUCKET MAKES MONEY, AND HOW WE KNOW BY BATCH 3

rows.claim: The Defensible Claim (Ring 2, conversion) feeds the Sprint via the Angle Map
rows.evidence: Working = at least 2 DMs/comments per batch from operating founders mentioning claims, launch, or proof. Below 2 across batches 2-3: swap in Launch Math. At 4+: add a third weekly slot

rows.claim: The Counter Files (Ring 2, trust) feeds the Angle Map
rows.evidence: Working = at least 1 'this is exactly my buyer' reply per batch plus operator saves. Below 1 across 2-3 batches: swap in The Convert

rows.claim: The Fix Aisle (Ring 4) is reach-only and says so
rows.evidence: Working = one 3x+ breakout per two batches AND at least 30% of engagers identifiably operating-founder tier. Reach without ring-fit by batch 3: re-aim the same skeleton at Ring 3 topics

List prices are real ($750 / $2,500). The 20% close and 30% upgrade rates are assumptions with zero sends logged - held as pending, hardened by the first ten sends. Expected value per qualified inquiry under assumptions: ~$300

sections.heading: chapters 4-5 · what we make, and *how*
sections.dek: Three buckets with named mechanisms; three vehicles - two proven pairs and one labeled bet.

items.action: The Claim Ladder: compression promise x talking-head + receipts
items.why: Proven pair (14.1x specimen); his payloads are enumerable; 60-90 minutes per rep, voice-memo-first because speech is the ore

items.action: The Regulatory News-Jack: shift analysis on the FTC/FDA beat
items.why: Proven skeleton (64.2x ceiling, person-effect flagged), unclaimed beat; Monday 20-minute sweep, 24-48 hour turnaround

items.action: The Counter Consult: self-witness with the claim ladder as paper prop - THE bet
items.why: Nobody in-pool runs self-witness monologue; one bet allowed, fallback written: guest the stories to the operator roundtables

items.action: Batch plan: 7/week in 3-2-1 shape, first kill/keep at batch 3, hero crowning at batch 3, scan refresh at day 45
items.why: No verdict inside 24 hours; no demotion before batches 2-3; the what-counts-as-working thresholds decide in dollars and counts

items.title: Batches 1-3
items.body: Sample batch as specified; chaos draw: ChatGPT-sameness demo first, FTC letter read second. Observation only - no verdicts.

items.title: First calibration pass
items.body: Kill/keep against the what-counts-as-working thresholds; hero-format crowning; the Counter Consult bet resolves or falls back.

items.title: Reps on heroes
items.body: Bench swaps per printed rules; chaos continues weekly, whitespace-tagged candidates first.

items.title: Topic scan refresh
items.body: The re-scan lights momentum with real deltas; re-cluster if buckets moved.

items.title: Second pass + scale
items.body: Third slot wherever a bucket beat its what-counts-as-working threshold twice over; Fix Aisle winners re-aimed at Ring 3 if ring-fit held.

sections.heading: the bet register, honestly
sections.kicker: WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS DOCUMENT WRONG
sections.body: Ten claims the strategy leans on are not yet hard, and each is listed with what hardens it: the close-rate assumptions (first ten sends), demand in the claim-science lane (batches 1-3 are the probe; zero rows is zero demand evidence), ring sizes (one keyword pull), the calm-practitioner style bet, the bucket mechanisms (comment-language reads), catalog-wide emptiness (per-channel search), one unverified forum quote, momentum direction (a second scan a day out), the Counter Consult format bet (fallback written), and one incumbent's self-reported revenue figure, used only as a positioning read and never to be republished as fact. Platform scope: this blueprint's evidence is YouTube-measured; TikTok and Instagram are not measured; LinkedIn - where the sales motion lives - sits outside this scan and is governed by his own logged sends.
